title: Temple Theft and Arms Smuggling
situation:
Narrative
You are a group of students who are coming from Rampur and going to Dhanpur in a van to represent your college in the
inter college fest which begins at 7:30 PM. You stopped at the tea shop at Solapur JN when you notice an injured man
lying in the tea shop bleeding profusely. On enquiring, he informed that he runs the tea shop and overheard a group of
three smugglers planning to loot antique idols from Ram temple at 6:30 PM. The smugglers then plan to make good
their escape towards the forest reserve. They attacked him when he threatened that he will inform the police and left him for
dead. He further added that the smugglers after destroying his STD booth went away in his jeep for looting. He gives
you the number of his jeep and requests you to find his jeep. On saying this he faints. While you were contemplating a
man comes running towards the tea shop from Solapur. He tells you he had overheard a few people along the road
discussing the landing of arms by boat at Solapur at 6:30 PM. As the mobile network and telephone lines were not working
in Solapur he was coming to the tea shop to inform the police from the STD booth. Time now is 4:30 PM. What will you
do?

title: Train Sabotage at Shanti Village
situation:
You are a group of 10 students returning to your hostel at Dholpur after a picnic at Rampur. Your vehicle developed a problem and you left it at a garage near a petrol pump, and your group decided to enjoy the ferry as your jeep will be repaired by 6 pm.

You stopped at a tea stall and while having tea, one of your friends found a rifle and accidentally fired a bullet which injured him in his shoulder.

While you were thinking about what to do, a boy came to seek your help as his father fell down near the wheat fields from his cart and broke his leg.

As he finished, a man came on a cycle and informed you that miscreants hidden in Shanti village are planning to remove fish plates of the railway track and blast a train going from Dholpur to Rampur which leaves at 4:45 pm, and they plan to blow it at 5:30 pm over the bridge.

The villagers are afraid of the goons, so they are not informing the police.

Just as he finished, a woman came asking for help as her cow was stranded in marshy land, and it is the only source of her livelihood.

It is 4:00 pm now, and you need to reach the hostel before 7 pm. You are also told that a bus leaves from Shampur to Dholpur at 5 pm. Boats are also available at the ferry. No telephone or mobile is working.

What will you do in such a situation?

title: Rafting Expedition and Headworks Sabotage
situation:
You (as many as in the group) have been selected from various units for taking part in a river rafting expedition and attached to a unit in Shakarpur. This morning prior to the expedition, you had set up a temporary camp for carrying out practice on Rajpur–Shakarpur canal.

This afternoon while some of you had already proceeded to the canal, a few of you were checking the equipment, when a person from TCP at Lanka village came running to the camp and said:

Sir, about 10 minutes ago, a bus approached the post master of Lanka village who had received information that some antisocial elements were planning to blow up the water head works at Rajpur at 1600 hrs.

He also said that the co-driver of a 3-ton vehicle noticed the height being slightly more than the tunnel, and this was a new 3-ton vehicle collected from Rajpur railway siding.

The person from TCP added that all telephone lines including civil lines are down.

Meanwhile one of you suddenly exclaimed that he had forgotten his life jacket at the unit location.

While you were planning the next course of action, one of the members of the group who had initially proceeded to the canal came running and informed that one of the boats had capsized, and one of the occupants had swallowed a lot of water and required immediate evacuation.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

The 1-ton vehicle attached to you had gone to Shakarpur and is likely to return by 1430 hrs.
The officer in charge of the rafting team has gone to the Engineer Regiment at Mirpur and will be back by 1700 hrs only.

Due to increased terrorist activities, you have been provided with arms and ammunition.

There is no police station nearby.
Time now is 1400 hrs.

What will you do in such a situation?

title: Crisis at Kali Lake and Kasori Forest
situation:
You are a group of students (as many as you are) from Govt Engineering college, Dilnagar. Your group had gone for a picnic to Kali Lake by the college van. While you were planning to return to your college for Inter College Musical Nite scheduled at 7.30 PM, one forest guard approached
your group for help. You observed that he was bleeding and limping badly.
On enquiry, he informed that he was beaten by a group of dacoits, who
were planning to steal the precious idol from Seba temple around 4 PM
and hand it over to smugglers hiding in Kasori Forest Reserve. The guard
also informed that another group had decided to loot the passanger train
between DilNagar and Sadak Pur near the Kasori Forest reserve Rail
Bridge on dhir Nadi. The Sadakpur – DilNagar passanger crosses the Dhir
Brige at about 4.30 PM. As you were contemplating you observed that a
young couple who had also come for picnic was shouting for assistance.
You turned and saw that the boat in which the young couple were sitting
was drowning and they were desperately screaming for help. You were still
in shock and trying to keep tour cool, when a fisherman came running for
help as his boat had broken her moorings and was drifting in the Kali Lake.
The time now is 3 PM. You as group of dynamic young students , how will
you handle the situation?
